svg.title: Words from the workshop
svg.desc: A slate card that rotates through four workshop rules in bone serif, framed by brass quote marks: Build something this week that a future teammate will be glad still exists. Ship the small version first. Then make it honest. Read the error. Then read it again, slower, before you touch the code. Leave every codebase a little warmer than the way you found it.
